svg.title: Outreach agent pipeline
svg.desc: Animated flowchart. Leads go from a Sales Nav URL through extract, a qualify decision, research, write, a critic decision and a human approve decision to outbox.jsonl. Not-fit leads are logged; edits and rejections become eval cases that a nightly learning decision uses to promote a better writer prompt.

g.text: Fit, researched, drafted, passes the critic, approved, lands in
Qualify says not fit, so the lead is logged and goes no further.
Critic fails the first draft and sends it back once. The rewrite
passes, the human rejects it, and it becomes an eval case.
Clean run: fit, passes the critic, approved, lands in the outbox.
Qualify says maybe, so the lead is logged for later instead of
The human edits the draft. The edited message goes to the outbox
and the edit is also saved as an eval case.
The human rejects the draft. It becomes the third eval case, which
is enough for tonight's learning run.
Overnight, a challenger prompt is scored against the champion on
the eval cases. It wins and passes the faithfulness gate, so the
The next morning's lead is drafted by the promoted v2 writer and

svg.text: DOT COLOR = WHERE THE LEAD ENDS UP
